meaning: A3 = 8.0 sets the amplitude of the third Gaussian bump (at t03 = 0.34) in the prescribed arterial pressure waveform of `Pressure_BC_Descriptor_2`. It is a hand-set default shaping the inlet forcing, not a fitted quantity.

could_move.what: Shape of the pulsatile inlet pressure, hence pulse amplitude and secondary peaks in downstream pressure/flow traces
Pulsatile-forcing basin results, where drive amplitude sits near a threshold
Patient fits, if this descriptor supplies the forcing there; fitted parameters may absorb a changed A3
Jugular-compression comparison figures between model variants

expectation: Direction: raising A3 raises the third peak and overall pulse amplitude; lowering it flattens the late waveform. Magnitude unknown. Whether any deck uses this default rather than overriding A3 is not visible in the context, so the effect on published figures cannot be inferred.

check.command: grep -rn "A3" Model_1 Model_3 Model_3_celia Model_1_celia targets
check.why: Shows whether decks and callers override A3 or inherit the 8.0 default, which decides if this value reaches any figure. Much cheaper than a re-fit.
